national_raw_news.content: Parliament has passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, after the Rajya Sabha returned the Money Bill to the Lok Sabha following discussion. The Lok Sabha had earlier passed the Bill, which was then sent to the Rajya Sabha for discussion. Since it is a Money Bill, the Rajya Sabha can only make recommendations on its provisions and return it to the Lok Sabha, which may accept or reject those recommendations. Replying to the discussion on the Bill in the Rajya Sabha, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman made it clear that the legislation does not impose any tax on UPI and that the digital payment system will remain free for consumers. The Finance Minister stated that the UPI-related amendment is only an enabling provision and does not itself impose any tax or transaction charge on users. Ms Sitharaman also said that the government does not intend to impose any MDR charges on small merchants, as they remain central to UPI’s inclusive growth.

national_raw_news.title: 3 hours ago | National 120 Government notifies 11 more International Ports for e-visa holders
national_raw_news.content: The Government has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling foreign nationals holding e-visas to enter India. The Home Ministry said the notification includes 9 land ports and 2 airports. These include airports at Bhopal and Tirupati and land ports at Attari and Agartala. The Ministry said the addition of these ports further enhances the attractiveness and utility of electronic visas. It noted that India processes approximately 95 per cent of e-visa applications in less than 72 hours. With the latest addition, the total number of International Ports enabling entry of foreign nationals holding e-visas has increased to 88, including 37 airports, 38 seaports and 13 land ports.

national_raw_news.title: 3 hours ago | Regional News 91 Jharkhand student leader Devendra Nath Mahto hospitalised; BJP calls Jharkhand bandh over lathi-c...
national_raw_news.content: Jharkhand student protest leader Devendra Nath Mahto has been hospitalised after his health deteriorated while taking part in the student-led Assembly march in Ranchi yesterday. Doctors described his condition as critical after a drastic drop in his blood sugar level. Mr Mahto has been on a hunger strike for 9 days over alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations in the state. Mr Mahto claims to have been injured during a police lathi-charge near the Jharkhand Assembly. The BJP has called for a Jharkhand bandh today to protest against “police atrocities” and the lathi-charge on protesting students. BJP state president Aditya Sahu said the bandh will be effective from 8 am till midnight today. He said all essential services, however, are excluded from the purview of the shutdown. Several agitators and 4 policemen were injured during a clash near the Jharkhand Assembly yesterday, as police used water cannons and tear gas and resorted to lathi-charge against job aspirants. The clash took place after the protesters breached multiple barricades near the Jharkhand Vidhan Sabha.

national_raw_news.title: 3 hours ago | International 710 7.4 magnitude earthquake strikes western Colombia, death toll rises to 132
national_raw_news.content: The death toll from a magnitude 7.4 earthquake that struck western Colombia on Monday has risen to 132, with more than 570 others injured. According to the US Geological Survey, the earthquake struck on Monday, with its epicentre near San Jose del Palmar in the Choco region, about 400 kilometres west of the capital, Bogota. The quake damaged hundreds of buildings and trapped several people under debris. Rescue teams and local residents searched through the rubble for survivors. Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella declared an emergency to speed up funding for relief and recovery operations. He said the government would provide all possible assistance to those affected. More than 20 municipalities across the country have reportedly been affected. The earthquake caused damage in cities including Pereira, Quibdo, Cali and Manizales. The tremors were also felt in neighbouring Ecuador and Panama, though no major damage was reported there. Authorities have warned of possible aftershocks and are continuing rescue and relief operations. Officials described it as the most powerful earthquake to hit Colombia in the last decade.

national_raw_news.title: 3 hours ago | Sports 66 India wins 17 medals, including 4 gold, on opening day of U-23 Commonwealth Fencing Championship
national_raw_news.content: India has made a strong start at the U-23 Commonwealth Fencing Championship in Lagos, Nigeria, winning 17 medals, including 4 gold, on the opening day. The Indian contingent has secured 4 gold, 4 silver and 9 bronze medals at the championship, which began on Sunday. Indian fencers reached the podium in all 6 individual events across the Sabre, Foil and Epee disciplines. In the men’s Sabre event, Nikhil Wagh won the gold medal, while Lakshay Badser secured silver. Ashwini Arya and Laishram Moramba bagged bronze medals. In men’s Foil, Tejas Patil won silver and Hemash Sanasam secured bronze. In men’s Epee, Lokesh Vemani claimed silver, while Shaurya Ashwini and Godwin Anbkess won bronze. In the women’s events, Joys Ashita clinched gold in Foil, with teammate Kanaglakshmi winning silver. Prachi Lohan won gold in women’s Epee, while Nivedhya Nair and Anupriya secured bronze medals. In women’s Sabre, Jeferlin bagged gold, Aakhari won silver and Shreya Gupta took bronze. India will look to build on its strong opening-day performance in the remaining events of the championship.

national_raw_news.title: IMD issues red warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall in Rajasthan, West Madhya Pradesh
national_raw_news.content: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall in Rajasthan and West Madhya Pradesh for today. The Met Department has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall over Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh for the next two days. The weather agency has predicted heavy rainfall conditions in Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Punjab, Chhattisgarh, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, East Madhya Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Madhya Maharashtra, Odisha and West Rajasthan for today. Similar weather conditions are likely to prevail over the North Eastern Region today. The IMD has also forecast thunderstorms over the Andaman and Nicobar Islands for the next 2 to 3 days. Meanwhile, thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds are expected to prevail over Andhra Pradesh, East Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Bihar till the 16th of this month. It added that Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Telangana, West Bengal, Sikkim, West Rajasthan, West Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Uttarakhand are also likely to witness thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds for the next two to three days.

national_raw_news.title: Nation pays homage to revolutionary freedom fighter Khudiram Bose on 119th martyrdom day
national_raw_news.content: The nation is paying homage today to revolutionary freedom fighter Khudiram Bose on his 119th martyrdom day. He was the first among the Indian revolutionaries in Bengal to be executed by the British on this day in 1908. Various programmes have been organised across the country to remember the young revolutionary and pay tribute to his supreme sacrifice. Khudiram Bose joined India’s freedom movement at a very young age and became one of the youngest martyrs of the anti-British struggle. At just 18, he took part in revolutionary activities aimed at ending British colonial rule. In 1908, Khudiram, along with revolutionary Prafulla Chaki, attempted to assassinate British magistrate Douglas Kingsford in Muzaffarpur, Bihar. On April 30, 1908, the 2 revolutionaries threw a bomb at a carriage they believed was carrying Kingsford. However, Kingsford was not in the carriage. 2 British women were killed in the blast. Prafulla Chaki later died by suicide while attempting to evade arrest, while Khudiram was captured by the British police. Following a trial, he was sentenced to death. Khudiram Bose was hanged at Muzaffarpur Central Jail on August 11, 1908. He faced death with remarkable courage and became an enduring symbol of patriotism, youthful courage and sacrifice. His supreme sacrifice continues to inspire generations and remains an important chapter in India’s freedom struggle.

national_raw_news.title: Indian Navy-US Navy EOD Exercise 2026 commences at Southern Naval Command
national_raw_news.content: The Indian Navy-US Navy Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Exercise 2026 commenced at the Southern Naval Command, Kochi, yesterday. The exercise will continue till the 14th of this month. The bilateral exercise aims to enhance interoperability and strengthen professional cooperation between the specialist diving and EOD teams of the two navies. The 5-day exercise will comprise Subject Matter Expert Exchanges, cross-training, equipment demonstrations and scenario-based practical exercises. The programme will facilitate the exchange of contemporary EOD methodologies, emerging technologies and best practices, while providing both sides an opportunity to gain insights into each other’s capabilities, operational concepts and employment philosophies. The exercise is designed to promote collaborative learning and operational synergy, enabling personnel from both navies to refine procedures, enhance mutual understanding and strengthen their ability to respond effectively to complex and evolving EOD challenges. The Indian Navy and US Navy have been conducting joint Salvage and EOD exercises since 2005. This engagement marks the 8th edition of this specialised bilateral training exercise.

national_raw_news.title: US to make online applications mandatory for several immigration benefits
national_raw_news.content: The United States will soon make online applications mandatory for several immigration benefits, including green cards, citizenship and asylum, in a move aimed at improving efficiency and reducing operational costs. The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) said in a new rule published in the Federal Register that forms which have been available for electronic filing for at least 180 days will be required to be submitted online. The rule will also establish a process to make immigration forms available exclusively online, after providing applicants with at least 60 days’ notice. The changes could affect a wide range of immigration benefits, including green card applications and renewals, family-based petitions, citizenship applications, asylum claims, employment authorisation and Temporary Protected Status filings. Applicants will generally be required to use a USCIS online account. They can either complete the form online or upload a PDF of the completed form along with supporting documents. The USCIS said the move is intended to streamline the immigration application process and lower administrative costs.

national_raw_news.title: U.S. federal court dismisses fraud and bribery case against Gautam Adani
national_raw_news.content: A U.S. federal court has dismissed criminal charges against Indian businessman Gautam Adani in an alleged fraud and bribery case. Brooklyn-based U.S. District Judge Nicholas Garaufis approved a request by federal prosecutors to drop the case. However, the judge expressed concern over the Justice Department’s decision to abandon the prosecution. The judge had sought clarification on the reasons for dropping the charges, including whether Mr Adani’s November 2024 pledge to invest 10 billion dollars in the United States had influenced the decision. Judge Garaufis said he was satisfied that the investment pledge had not played a role in the Justice Department’s decision. He also noted that the role of courts in reviewing prosecutors’ decisions to drop federal criminal charges is limited. Reacting to the court’s decision, Gautam Adani said he welcomed it with humility and deep respect for the judicial process. He said that throughout the challenging period, his faith in truth, fairness and the rule of law remained unwavering. Mr Adani expressed gratitude to those who continued to have faith in him, the legal system and India’s capacity for justice. He said the Adani Group would remain committed to nation-building, creating lasting value and serving a larger purpose.

national_raw_news.title: India, Israel discuss ways to deepen development partnership through MASHAV
national_raw_news.content: India’s Ambassador to Israel, J.P. Singh, met the Head of MASHAV, Israel’s Agency for International Development Cooperation, Eynat Shlein, in Jerusalem to discuss ways to further expand and deepen the India-Israel development partnership through MASHAV. The discussions covered cooperation in several areas, including Centres of Excellence in agriculture, capacity building in agriculture and water management, and new avenues of cooperation in aquaculture. The Indian Embassy in Israel said the two sides also exchanged views on further strengthening the partnership. MASHAV, under Israel’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was established to share Israeli knowledge, expertise and technologies with other countries to help them address development challenges.

national_raw_news.title: Hockey World Cup to be played in new format; quarterfinal stage scrapped 10 Aug 2026 | 6:16 PM 229
national_raw_news.content: The FIH Hockey Men’s and Women’s World Cup 2026 will feature a revamped competition structure, with the traditional quarterfinal stage scrapped and the top two teams from each of the two crossover pools advancing directly to the semi-finals. Belgium and the Netherlands jointly host the tournament from August 15 to 30. The new format means teams will have little margin for error from the outset, with results from the opening pool stage potentially carrying over into the next phase. India’s men have been drawn alongside England, Pakistan and Wales in Pool D, while the Indian women will face China, England and South Africa in their Pool D campaign. The tournament will begin with the 16 teams in each competition split across four pools of four. From August 15 to 20, every team will play three matches against the other sides in its pool, with the final standings determining the composition of the next phase. The top two teams from Pools A and D will move into Pool E, while the leading two teams from Pools B and C will form Pool F. The top two finishers from Pool E and Pool F will advance directly to the last four. The women’s tournament will conclude in the Netherlands on August 29, with the bronze-medal match followed by the final. The men’s World Cup will conclude in Belgium a day later, on August 30, with its bronze-medal match and final.

national_raw_news.title: India secures two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US 10 Aug 2026 | 1:34 PM 241
national_raw_news.content: In the World Athletics U20 Championships, India enjoyed a historic day in Eugene, USA, with Basant Kumar Meghwal and Shahnavaz Khan becoming the first Indians to win medals in the high jump and long jump at the championships. Basant Kumar Meghwal, the reigning Asian U20 champion, won silver in the men’s high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres. Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in the men’s long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres. Algeria’s Younes Ayachi won the high jump gold, while Great Britain’s Otis Poole took bronze. The two medals took India’s tally at the championships to three. India have now equalled their medal haul from the 2021 and 2022 editions.

national_raw_news.title: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal highlights GeM’s role in transparent public procurement 4 hours ago 72
national_raw_news.content: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has said that the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) reflects the procurement of the right product of the right quality, at the right price and at the right time. The Minister said this while speaking at the 10th Foundation Day of GeM in New Delhi yesterday. Mr Goyal recalled that prior to the introduction of GeM, public money was being misused, procurement was non-transparent and lacked good governance. He underlined that today, procurement is being carried out through a public procurement e-commerce platform, where transparency, competitiveness and strong standards are maintained before registration. Mr Goyal said GeM is an effort to digitise public procurement and replace opacity with transparency. He noted that since the introduction of the GeM portal, its gross merchandise value has grown to over five lakh crore rupees per year over the last two years, from over four hundred crore rupees in 2016-17. Mr Goyal said cumulatively, GeM has helped in the procurement of over twenty lakh crore rupees worth of goods and services through the portal, through more than three crore orders. He underlined that procurement worth ten lakh crore rupees took place in the first eight years, while the next ten lakh crore rupees was covered in only two years. The Minister mentioned that over 2.25 lakh women-led enterprises have won orders worth nearly one lakh crore rupees through the portal. He added that over 42,000 start-ups have carried out business with government enterprises worth almost 66,000 crore rupees. Mr Goyal informed that GeM is being revamped and a new user-friendly, AI-enabled portal will be launched soon. The Minister also launched a dedicated nationwide five-digit short code, 14550, for the GeM Helpdesk, enabling buyers, sellers and other stakeholders to access support and identify official GeM communications.
